managerAiMvp.currentRule: Manager is a built-in Role, not a standalone issue publisher.
activeBehavior: the /:workspaceSlug/manager page displays the built-in manager role
the /:workspaceSlug/manager page shows manager role invocation history
forbiddenBehavior: do not use /api/manager/plan from the Manager page
do not create Manager/Builder/Tester issues from the Manager page
do not fall back to the legacy Manager issue publisher when Role Registry is missing manager

roleAiOrganizationMvp.goal: Generalize Manager AI into the first built-in role of a configurable AI organization system.
corePrinciples: Role defines responsibility, permissions, channels, approval policy, and prompt
Agent/runtime is an executor binding for a role
Natural language creates structured actions, not direct high-risk execution
QQ is an input/output channel, not an execution authority
safetyGates: QQ commands do not directly execute high-risk actions
role invocations and actions are audit-backed
firstStageAcceptance: built-in Manager/Builder/Tester roles are available per workspace
operator can route a Web/internal_chat/QQ message to a role
high-risk routed messages create approval requests
Manager page routes @manager messages through Role Router
Manager page does not call /api/manager/plan or create legacy manager issues

l3AutonomousExecution.goal: Move from L2 approved manual execution toward L3 automatic execution of approved Builder role actions without automatic production deployment.

runtimeSplit.policy: GLM is the QQ personality/research/planning runtime; Codex is the approved code/test/repo execution runtime.
boundaries: GLM may decide, discuss, summarize, research, and create action contracts.
GLM must not directly write the repository, run shell commands, or commit.
Codex may edit files, run commands, test, and commit only after role_actions are approved.
Codex must not handle QQ social chat or personality watering.
Codex returns artifacts; GLM/CEO reports those artifacts to QQ.

productionExecutionRuntime.entry: approved role_actions claimed by Mortis dispatcher

studioOS.policy: The next bottleneck is AI Studio Infrastructure: shared operational context, observability, artifacts, verification, and durable memory. Do not solve this by adding more persona prompt.
priority: P0 independent tester-local-verifier and reliable Builder branch handoff
P1 shared operational state for active/blocked tasks
P1 artifact-first delivery through studio_artifacts and OpenList
P2 Digital Human Behavior Layer: feed, mood, saved items, emotion-driven sharing, OpenList media/file artifacts
P2 long-term organization memory and private LLM deliberation

lifeRuntime.policy: Do not fake human behavior with random emojis or random files. Digital-human expression must come from continuous feed, mood/current interest, saved items, and a relevant sharing trigger.
lifeRuntime.currentStatus: partial: QQ public feed capture and idle life pulses exist; external Bilibili/GitHub/blog/browser ingestion and QQ media/file sharing tools are still missing.

owners.watcher: continuous feed ingestion and research cards
owners.builder: technical repos/videos saved for implementation discussions
owners.ceo: daily studio summaries and direction-setting shares

studioOS.truthRule: Agents must cite real action, invocation, artifact, command, CI/log evidence, feed item, saved item, or explicit blocked reason. QQ discussion alone is not delivery.

flow: manager role routes and requests approval
builder runtime clones repository into isolated work root

environment.MORTIS_ROLE_DISPATCHER_ENABLED: false by default; true starts dispatcher
environment.MORTIS_ROLE_REPO_URL: git@github.com:emptyinkpot/mortis.git; production may use file:///source for local clone reliability
environment.MORTIS_CODEX_DANGEROUSLY_BYPASS_SANDBOX: false by default; production currently true because Docker host blocks Codex workspace-write user namespaces
environment.MORTIS_QQ_NOTIFY_ENABLED: false by default; true starts OneBot completion notifier
environment.MORTIS_QQ_ONEBOT_HTTP_URL: OneBot HTTP base URL for QQ outbound messages
environment.MORTIS_QQ_ONEBOT_HTTP_URLS: optional JSON or CSV map from OneBot self_id to OneBot HTTP URL; completion notifier uses the original receiving QQ when available
environment.MORTIS_QQ_NOTIFY_TARGET_TYPE: optional fallback target type: group or private
environment.MORTIS_QQ_INBOUND_SECRET: optional shared secret for NapCat OneBot httpClients
environment.MORTIS_QQ_INBOUND_WORKSPACE_SLUG: workspace receiving QQ routed role messages
environment.MORTIS_QQ_INBOUND_AUTO_APPROVE_LOW_RISK: true auto-approves low-risk builder messages from QQ
environment.MORTIS_QQ_BOT_USER_IDS: comma-separated QQ UINs for bot accounts; inbound bridge ignores these senders to prevent bot-to-bot loops
environment.MORTIS_QQ_INBOUND_CONVERSATION_KEY: conversation_threads.external_thread_key for the company room; default company-room
environment.MORTIS_QQ_LIVING_AGENTS_ENABLED: false by default; true starts the QQ living agents polling runtime
environment.MORTIS_QQ_LIVING_GROUP_ID: QQ group id watched by the living agents runtime
environment.MORTIS_QQ_LLM_BASE_URL: conversation GLM gateway; production uses https://sub2api.tengokukk.com/v1
environment.MORTIS_QQ_LLM_MODEL: conversation GLM model; production uses coze-shell backed by coze-glm-proxy
environment.MORTIS_AI_CEO_ONEBOT_URL: OneBot HTTP URL used by the CEO agent account
environment.MORTIS_AI_BUILDER_ONEBOT_URL: OneBot HTTP URL used by the Builder agent account
environment.MORTIS_AI_TESTER_ONEBOT_URL: OneBot HTTP URL used by the Tester agent account
environment.MORTIS_AI_WATCHER_ONEBOT_URL: OneBot HTTP URL used by the Watcher agent account

safetyBoundaries: dispatcher is disabled unless explicitly enabled
dispatcher only claims approved role_actions for the built-in builder role
builder works in a fresh clone under MORTIS_AGENT_WORK_ROOT
builder commits locally but does not push main, merge, or deploy
production deployment still requires operator or deploy gate
acceptanceGates: single approved builder action is automatically claimed and reaches running or completed
codex or test failure records failed or blocked without fake success
dispatcher can pick the next approved builder action after one finishes
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED prevents duplicate claims when multiple dispatchers run
24h run has no stuck state, illegal transition, or automatic deploy

packageBoundaries: packages/views has no direct next/* or react-router-dom imports
apps/web/platform is the Next.js adaptation layer

doNotUseAs: legacy rollback source unless explicitly requested
